svg.title: Component inventory and adoption
svg.text: 80+ components, and proof anyone is using them
A library nobody adopts is a hobby. Adoption is measured in CI and posted to the team channel every Monday.
Plus 12 patterns (search, filter bar, form layout, empty-to-first-run, destructive confirm…) documented as compositions, not new components.
Adoption — % of UI built from the library
Measured by an AST scan of every product repo on each merge to main.
Same reviewer, same checklist. “Wrong shade of grey” has not appeared since release 3.
